_comment: Deploy-time default config. The UI overrides this at runtime (stored in I/O State). Replace the YOUR_* placeholders, or just configure everything in the app's Configure tab. Env pair (programId/sourceEnvId/destEnvId) is per-job. Content sets are author-tier only; each carries a publish flag (default true) — publish paths are derived from the sets, no separate publishPaths list. Do not commit secrets here.
